build_changes: Use declared plan_env/path_searching dependencies instead of sibling/source/workspace path guesses.
Export traj_utils_so library target; consume modern targets through ament and remove redundant raw library expansion.

historical_attempts.result: Main node linker actively interrupted after more than 8 minutes; redundant raw library expansion removed, original compiler flags preserved.
8 vendor packages built; adapter dependency graph needed previously migrated pointcloud_filters/tag_pose underlay prefixes. Verification setup corrected in matrix-v2.

limitations: Exact upstream repository/fork/branch/commit unknown; local history is not an upstream version lock.
Original TODO/mixed license metadata preserved; no unified root license inferred.
Uses existing ROS/main/scene and ALG-4/5 support underlays; not a full workspace clean rebuild.
EGO stays a ROS/PCL engine; installed consumer uses ROS serialization, not ROS-free computation.
AStar library symbol and original actual planner tests exercised; no new standalone 3D search benchmark or flight qualification.
Copy relocation uses explicit CMake/AMENT/library/Python package prefixes, not arbitrary generated colcon shell setup relocation.
Main installation and running user simulation preserved; local old-path bridge remains until consumers are retired.
ALG0-B03 and historical semantic shutdown/stress issues remain unresolved; no PX4/Gazebo started or flight commands sent.
